vo_open.text: Something flattened a whole forest. And left no crater.

vo.text: June 30th, 1908. Siberia. A blast over the Tunguska River.
It flattened about two thousand one hundred fifty square kilometers of forest.
The shock wave knocked people down more than sixty kilometers away.
No crater, because it exploded in the air, five to ten kilometers up.
vo.cap: No crater: it exploded *in the air.* *5–10 km* up.
